text: {"label":"Driving, Traffic, and Pedestrian Safety Behavior","definition":"Applied and quantitative analyses of road-user behavior, including driver yielding at crosswalks, in-street sign treatments, seat belt use, following distance, texting while driving, eco-driving feedback, and parking compliance.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on drivers, pedestrians, and traffic settings, unlike teaching general safety skills to children, disseminating behavior science, or broad behavior-modification and behavior-plan issues."}
